profile_text: As a specialist in painting, renovation, and restoration services, this Düsseldorf-based firm has established itself as a trusted provider of high-quality coatings and finishes. Despite a recent decline in growth, its categorization as a Gazelle suggests a strong potential for future expansion and innovation in the construction sector.
